root_cause_verification.rationale: The root cause was that toolFullViewRegistry only had MultiEdit, missing Task and Agent entries. The fix adds both. Verified in source (_all.tsx lines 54-55), in the bundle (toolFullViewRegistry found in built JS), and in the running app (clicking Agent tool card now shows Sub-tools with 96+ children instead of just Description+Input+Output).
